reason: In src/sentry/api/paginator.py:877-882, when enable_advanced_features is true and cursor.offset < 0, OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_result slices the Django QuerySet directly with the negative start_offset (queryset[start_offset:stop]), which raises ValueError because Django QuerySets forbid negative indexing. Neither get_result nor Endpoint.paginate (src/sentry/api/base.py:525-540, which only catches BadPaginationError) converts this error, so an uncaught exception from a cursor like 0:-10:0 returns HTTP 500.
